criteria: An attack, guard, open file or isolated later contact cannot by itself establish a complete purpose explanation.

The selected account must tie the actual played/reference choices to their returned replies and distinguish supported realization, prevention or tradeoff; essential prices and delayed uses stay attached.
Choose between available purposes by evidence connecting the actual comparison and reply outcomes, not a fixed preference for attack/piece type or the first returned contact.

changes: PurposeEvidence separates useful realization, actual-pair comparison, qualified reply evidence, and stronger independent reply ownership. The same receipts rank both candidate families.

Functional contacts alone no longer complete a root purpose. An incidental guard route cannot outrank a realized beneficiary. Actual evaluated paths take precedence over a different surveyed idea when both have evidence.

One realized reply and another bounded failure can explain a conditional purpose. Re2 retains the negative Rae1/Nxc6 test and selects independent Nd5 realization instead of repeating Bb5 non-realization.
A shield accepted by capture closes its local exchange; Qa4 no longer borrows distant Qf5 merely to fill a missing purpose. Continuing pawn function remains after its original pawn is exchanged.

Scheduler and delivery share enriched actual-pair reading. An exhausted bounded inquiry may finish with an explicitly incomplete explanation. Kh1 keeps the actual Qe2 comparison rather than opening a redundant Nd4 root.
Prepared actual alternatives retain original attacked targets; frontend independently verifies their exact ownership and geometry.
limitations: These saved-report checks do not establish fresh-screen generalization.

changes: Put the selected functional purpose and its actual immediate alternative before factual inventories and checkpoints. Reply differences precede final-state lists.

Keep separate costs, delayed realization, actual root references and independent frontend ownership checks.
Admit useful delayed activity from the actual assessed root into the same candidate pool as independent reply surveys; use the selected task to own the next response question.
Rank any displayed two-reply comparison by its owned search before stating a weaker reply as an alternative.

Compare the same original supported piece at its actual entry in both assessed lines. State the same provider support difference at those witnessed points; do not infer absence from an unobserved entry or deny other defenders.
